$schema.description: Path to this JSON Schema: editor autocomplete only, ignored by the loader.

id.description: Unique id of the line, lower_snake_case.

reaction.description: Which of her three reactions says it: `laugh`, `sigh` or `scream`.

text.description: What she says, in French, tutoiement. `*word*` is shown in italics.

when.description: Absent: a generic line of its reaction, the fallback when no other line holds.

tag.description: A gag id (`stairs_slide`, `outlet_hair`…) that must have happened in the game she is shown; `content:check` knows the ids.

minPrevious.description: With `tag`: in how many *previous* games the tag must have happened at least (0 = first time or not, 1 = « encore »).

lines.description: Every line she can say. The most specific one that holds wins; a seeded draw breaks a tie.

description: What Mama says on the Result screen, and when (story 3.8, FR36).
